result:
Solution 1 is wrong. Its answer of 2 is below the lower bound from $K_4$: $\chi_l(K_4)=4$ and $\chi_l^{\star}(G)\ge\chi_l(G)$, so $t(3)\ge 4$.

Solution 2's upper-bound argument does not hold. Its Hall's-condition check assumes each clique neighbor forbids a color at a unique position, and that the forbidden sets combine cleanly across the bag. Neither assumption is justified, so the claimed bound $\chi_l^{\star}(G)\le 4$ for all treewidth-3 graphs is unsupported.

Solution 3's argument is also flawed. Its inequality $k-d\ge d$ is never shown to be necessary or sufficient, and its lower-bound construction yields only $t(d)\ge 2d$ with a sketch that doesn't check out. The value 6 is not established.

I don't have a reliable recollection of the exact published value of $t(3)$. The literature I half-remember on list packing of bounded-treewidth graphs suggests values above 4 for $d=3$, which would rule out Solution 2 as well, but I can't verify this here. So I can't confirm that any of the three is correct.

CHOICE: NONE
CONFIDENCE: 3
